# CHANGES — prompt2: discriminator encoding normalization

## Summary
`decode_bytes` in `src/codama_convert.rs` now decodes all Codama `bytesValueNode`
encodings to the underlying bytes:
- Base16: hex (unchanged)
- Base58: `bs58` crate, fallback to raw string bytes on error
- Base64: `base64` 0.22 STANDARD engine, same fallback
- Utf8: raw string bytes (the value itself)

Added `decode_encoded_bytes` for tests. Doc comment explains false-positive avoidance
when the same disc is written as base16 vs base58/base64 across IDL versions
(Vixen PR #277 / Codama bumps).

## Dependencies
- `bs58 = "0.5"` → locked `bs58 v0.5.1` (fetched from crates.io; was not fully vendored locally before `cargo fetch`)
- `base64 = "0.22"` → locked `base64 v0.22.1` (fetched; registry already had sources after fetch)

## Tests
- `same_discriminator_two_encodings_is_no_change`: unit-checks base16/base58/base64 of
  `[1,2,3,4]` decode equal, and diffs Codama RootNodes with the same account disc as
  base16 vs base58 → no breaking, zero discriminator-change entries.

## Test count
- **17 passed** in `tests/diff_tests.rs` (16 prior + 1 new)
